evidence: decorative_mascot: From hook@0.3 to seg1:end Data stands in the same spot by the CREW door, waving the same way while the crew file out. At seg2:start through seg2:end he holds a phone to his ear beside the globe. He only does real work at seg3, where he drives the tug that pushes the planes.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: From seg2:start to seg2:end the globe only lights up blobs labelled China, then Eurasia. The headline swaps 134,000 for 143,000, a loose "MOST" word floats in the top right, and Data stands beside the globe on a phone.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The claim is a ranking (Eurasia narrowly beats China and the US is not first), but the picture is one highlight at a time. The viewer never sees the regions side by side, so 'just ahead' and 'Nope, not the US' are never shown, and Data has no role in it.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show the regions competing in one picture, e.g. queues of pilots on each region of the globe or a podium. Eurasia's line should land just longer than China's, with the US visibly behind. Data should do the measuring or the stacking himself, and the floating 'MOST' tag should go.
